items.html: And we shall explain the order of the exit of the seven kings. Let us begin with the first, which is Daat, which came out first. And since the vessel could not bear it, as was said above, the vessel broke and fell down to the world of Beria, meaning to the place where the world of Beria was destined to be afterward, for the world of Beria had not yet been created. And this vessel fell in the place of Daat of Beria, being related to it as its like. And indeed the light of Daat descended as well, except that it remained in Atzilut itself, in the place of the vessel of Malchut of Atzilut.
